# Eratosthenes

> Eratosthenes (also called SciCo-Search) is an AI research assistant for academic literature search. It turns a research topic into a set of optimized academic queries, reads and ranks the papers by how well they match your intent rather than by keyword overlap, maps the field into themed branches so under-explored research gaps stand out, and profiles the principal investigators and labs behind the work. It is built for PhD students, postdocs, and researchers scoping a literature review, entering a new field, or looking for labs to work with. Live at https://search.scicoagent.com.

## What Eratosthenes does

- AI query expansion: a plain-language research interest becomes many optimized academic queries, with synonyms and broader terms. A "Query Entropy" setting widens or narrows the net.
- AI relevance match: every retrieved paper is read and scored against your stated intent. The AI Match score ranks results by conceptual overlap, not by shared keywords.
- Topic map and research gaps: an interactive map groups the papers into themed branches, with a mind map that walks from the well-studied core of a field out toward its under-explored frontier.
- PI and lab profiling: a second phase profiles the principal investigators behind the papers, covering their recent output, lab focus, and fit with your research direction.
- Saved sessions: sign in with Google and every search is saved to your account, so you can restore any past session.

## How a search works

1. Define your search: type a specific research interest and set the Query Entropy.
2. Auto-expand and search: the AI expands the topic into optimized queries and harvests the literature.
3. Harvest and rank: papers are retrieved and scored by how well they match your intent.
4. Map and profile: explore the topic map and profile the labs behind the work.

## How it differs from keyword search

Keyword search engines return papers that share your words, and ranking them by real relevance is left to you. Eratosthenes treats a search as a strategy: it expands the question, scores each paper for meaning, and organizes the results into a map, so the gaps in a field are visible without reading dozens of papers first. It also goes past papers to the people, by profiling the labs and PIs doing the work.

## Pricing

All plans include unlimited quick search and topic maps. Quotas reset monthly. Prices are in US dollars; annual billing saves up to 40%.

- Free ($0): unlimited quick search and topic maps, 3 deep searches and 3 Research-Gap Graphs a month, the author and PI finder, saved sessions and citation export.
- Pro ($15 a month, or $9 a month billed yearly): 30 deep searches and 30 Research-Gap Graphs a month.
- Max ($39 a month, or $24 a month billed yearly): unlimited deep searches and Research-Gap Graphs (fair use, up to 300 a month), and the research-plan generator when it launches.
- Team ($24 per seat a month, or $15 per seat a month billed yearly, from 3 seats): Pro for every member, on one invoice.

## About

Eratosthenes is named after the ancient Greek polymath and chief librarian of the Library of Alexandria. It is part of SciCoagent (https://scicoagent.com), an ecosystem of AI scientist co-agents that aim to cut trial and error across research gap identification, experiment design, and academic writing. Its sibling, Benjamin (https://benjamin.scicoagent.com), proofreads scientific manuscripts. Contact: contact@scicoagent.com.
